# TinyCC 0.9.27 Win64

This directory contains the official TinyCC 0.9.27 Win64 binary
distribution used by the OpenC SH-5 Windows backend.

TinyCC is a separate work and is licensed under the GNU Lesser General
Public License, version 2.1. The license text is in `COPYING`. The official
Win64 distribution also contains headers carrying their own upstream terms:
most declare public-domain status, and `include/tcc/tcc_libm.h` contains its
MIT license notice. Per-file notices control. OpenC's 0BSD license does not
apply to these files.

Upstream:

- Project: <https://savannah.nongnu.org/projects/tinycc/>
- Binary archive:
  <https://download-mirror.savannah.gnu.org/releases/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27-win64-bin.zip>
- Corresponding source:
  <https://download-mirror.savannah.gnu.org/releases/tinycc/tcc-0.9.27.tar.bz2>
